NEW VIDEOS WEEKLY AT 8:00AM PST / 3:00PM GMT

•MAGIC MONDAYS
Performances, puzzles, and anything that has to do with the art of magic. The Magic for Muggles series will find a home here as well! If you love magic but don't want the secrets ruined, this is for you!

•YOU CHOOSE TUESDAYS
Content that you as a community have voted on in polls. It will also feature monthly Q&A segments where I’ll compile your questions from the weeks leading up and blind respond to them. The Q&A will always be the first Tuesday of the month.

•WORKER WEDNESDAYS
Real performers who want to learn how to become even better will find home here. Whether you are a beginner, hobbyist, or professional, if you are willing to put in the work, this is the content for you!

•THOUGHTS ON THURSDAYS
Chisme, gossip, and otherwise just whatever is on my mind. The latest news in the magic world, podcast episodes, and special guests!

•FREESTYLE FRIDAYS
You never know what you are going to get! Is it a product review? Reaction video? Who knows! I sure don’t. It will be fun for all of us!

•WORKBOOK WEEKENDS
Saturdays and Sundays are dedicated to teaching magic. Things you need to learn and practice. As of now (and until the end of May 2027 lol) this segment is taken over by “The Imagine Nation Project” audio book series.

Michael O'Brien is a multiple time award winning magician in Orange County and Los Angeles, CA who specializes in Closeup Magic and Stage Mentalism. As seen on Penn & Teller Fool Us, Good Morning America, and America's Got Talent, Michael is known for his unique approach which is designed to invoke a sense of wonder, fun, nostalgia, and excitement like no other!

When Michael is not performing at events like yours, he spends his time teaching as a Professor of Magic at the world famous Magic Castle in Hollywood. Michael is also an international sensation, awarded as an Associate of the Inner Magic Circle with a Silver Star at the Magic Circle in London in the United Kingdom. In his spare time he manages his own YouTube channel with with over 4 million hits dedicated to furthering the art of magic worldwide!

If you want to improve your sleight of hand, learn what it takes to become a better magician, or want to start working as a professional, then this is the channel for you! Whether you want to perfect your double lift or want your stage magic persona to shine through, Michael has something for everyone!
